blocks.text: Queue bank ya ticket counter ke saamne lagi line jaisi hai. Jo shakhs pehle line mein laga, usi ki baari pehle aati hai. Computer mein queue bhi isi tarah kaam karti hai: jo item pehle dala gaya, wohi pehle nikalta hai. Bank ki line ki tarah naya item peeche (back) jurta hai aur item aage (front) se nikalta hai. Isay FIFO (First-In, First-Out) principle (usool) kehte hain, jaisa Figure 4.3 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Line mein khare logon ke kaale khaake (silhouettes), peeche ki taraf chhote hote hue. 'remove' wala teer dikhata hai ke aage wala shakhs nikal raha hai, aur ek mura hua teer dikhata hai ke naya shakhs peeche aa kar shamil ho raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.3: Bank ke saamne logon ki line (kitab ki Figure 4.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Queue mein pehle kis ki baari aati hai, aur naya aane wala kahan lagta hai?
blocks.explanation: Aage wale ki, jo sab se pehle aaya tha. Naya aane wala sab se peeche lagta hai.

items: Queue: peeche jorein, aage se nikalein; First-In, First-Out (FIFO).
